funds.directEquityBasis: Official manager materials describe long-term equity investments in private mid-market infrastructure businesses.

northAmericaQualification.rationale: Official manager materials explicitly state Europe and North America as core geographic mandate.

snapshot.investmentStrategy: Mid-market direct equity infrastructure strategy investing across transport, utilities, telecoms, energy & environment and social infrastructure in Europe and North America.

evidence.title: iCON Infrastructure official website
evidence.evidenceSummary: The manager states that its latest fund has $3.7B of commitments and invests in private mid-market infrastructure businesses across Europe and North America. The disclosure was observed on the official website when retrieved on 2026-07-29; that retrieval date is used as the amount observation date, not as a separately disclosed close date.

funds.repoDispositionRationale: The repository uses an outdated fund name and lifecycle classification and does not classify the disclosed commitments amount. Official materials support the corrected name, financial-close status, commitments classification and 2025 vintage. Because the official website does not provide a separate date for the commitments figure, the 2026-07-29 retrieval date is recorded as the observation date.

unresolvedConflicts.subject: Earlier iCON fund vintages (III–VI)
unresolvedConflicts.issue: Multiple prior funds appear to have current North American holdings but lack fully up-to-date fund-attributed lifecycle and holding evidence meeting strict inclusion criteria as of the as-of date.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Obtain current portfolio attribution or recent company disclosures explicitly tying holdings to specific fund vehicles.

notes: Strict evidence standard limits inclusion to Fund VII with explicit mandate evidence.
The 2026-07-29 sizeAsOf value is the observation date of the current official website disclosure, not an inferred fund-close date.
